## Retry interface

How a call of the loader (a load or a dry run) is tried again after it threw an error the run calls retryable (`RunOptions.retryable`<!-- -->). The wait before retry n is a random time up to `initialMs × factor^(n-1)`<!-- -->, at most `maxMs` (full jitter), and never ends past the run's deadline.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Retry 
```
